projection_boundary: Source-side references only. Records may generate current-company questions, rival checks, evidence priority, and conditional treatment. They are not current-company facts, probabilities, CJO values, valuation inputs, BuyBand, report authority, or investment actions.

records.proposition: In a capital-intensive manufacturing expansion under price pressure, installed capacity or scale does not establish durable economics until responsibility-matched price, cost or mix, cash-capex absorption, and financing or recoverability evidence support the same path.
records.decision_or_no_action: Continue capacity and technology deployment while product economics and internal-cash coverage remain unresolved.
records.mechanism_chain: capacity and scale -> same-boundary price, cost and product mix -> operating cash minus cash capital expenditure -> financing and recoverability investigation
observable_signals: Same-boundary revenue and margin rather than capacity or a combined volume series.
Operating cash and cash capital expenditure under the same responsibility boundary.
A directly disclosed financing or recoverability bridge when permanent-loss treatment depends on it.
records.strongest_rival: A cyclical price and cost recovery can restore returns before capacity is reduced, so one weak period does not prove that the manufacturing base is permanently impaired.
apply_when: The target has a capital-intensive manufacturing expansion and a cutoff-visible risk that scale is being used as a proxy for unit economics.
The target can be examined through a responsibility-matched product or business-line economics carrier and a cash-capex carrier.
do_not_apply_when: The target lacks a comparable responsibility boundary for either economics or cash, in which case the affected claim stays conditional rather than being inferred from group results.
A capacity completion, aggregate shipment, group liquidity, or one-period cash number is being substituted for the full mechanism.
records.investor_relevance: Keep incremental capacity outside normal owner-cash treatment until current-company product economics and cash absorption are independently supported; investigate permanent-loss transmission without calling an unresolved cash screen a complete conclusion.

records.proposition: A profitable core, a new option, and group cash must remain on their own responsibility boundaries; deployment examples or group cash cannot establish the option's recurring economics.
records.decision_or_no_action: Continue core investment while treating new-option economics as unresolved.
records.mechanism_chain: core cash and new-option deployment -> responsibility-matched recurring revenue and profit -> attributable cash treatment
observable_signals: A target business-line revenue, profit or cash carrier rather than aggregate group cash.
A current-company discriminator showing whether the incremental line absorbs capital on its own economics.
records.strongest_rival: Early technology or new-line investment can create a valuable option before separate recurring economics are disclosed.
apply_when: A target has a mature core and a separately discussed incremental business line whose economics could be masked by group cash.
do_not_apply_when: The target's cash and incremental economics are already reported at the same responsibility boundary.
A group cash figure is being used as proof that the incremental line has earned a return.
records.investor_relevance: Preserve a plausible option in a named scenario, but exclude it from the current base cash treatment until current-company evidence closes the responsibility boundary.

feedback_events.explanation: FY2024 consolidated operating cash exceeded the frozen cash-capex carrier by RMB1.027bn, clearing one target cash leg. The same source does not settle customer absorption, utilization, realized price or spread, product economics, or funding/recoverability, so it cannot distinguish the Longi-derived question from the target recovery rival or grant transfer credit.

invocation_receipts.structural_match: Both cases are expansion-stage capital-intensive B2B manufacturing situations where capacity or scale can be mistaken for durable product economics and cash, while the target remains an upstream solar-glass supplier rather than a vertically integrated module producer.
mismatch_dimensions: The target product, customer interface, product mix, technology path and funding structure must be rebuilt from its own cutoff-visible evidence.
accepted_transfer: Test the responsibility-boundary bridge in the frozen order: capacity or commissioning -> customer absorption or utilization -> realized price or spread -> operating cash -> cash capital expenditure and funding or recoverability.
Exclude capacity-driven growth from base normal owner-cash treatment until the target bridge is supported.
rejected_transfer: Do not import the Longi outcome, threshold, product mix, financing fact, probability or conclusion.
Do not treat an unresolved target carrier as target failure or capacity destruction.
invocation_receipts.changed_investor_treatment: Keep capacity-driven growth outside base normal owner-cash treatment until current-company product economics and cash absorption are supported; preserve the recovery rival as a named scenario rather than a conclusion.
